name: Gemini CLI
desc: Apache-2.0 open-source terminal agent for Gemini models
desc_zh: Apache-2.0 开源终端智能体，驱动 Gemini 系列模型
solves: Autocomplete only knows the line you are on. It reads the repo and does multi-file work from your shell.
solves_zh: 自动补全只认得光标所在的那一行。它会读整个仓库，直接在 shell 里完成跨文件的活。
best_for: When you want agent work without leaving the terminal or paying for another editor.
best_for_zh: 当你想用 Agent 干活，却不想离开终端、也不想为另一个编辑器付费。
